# Grid Zoom

**Motion › Zoom** · v1.0.0 · 54 frames at 30 fps (30–100)

The camera pulls back until the old scene is one tile in a grid of tiles in the new colour, glides to the next tile and dives into it, which becomes the new scene.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/grid-zoom@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Changing topic within a series
- Galleries and portfolios
- Explainers with many sections

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import gridZoom from './transitions/05-motion/zoom/grid-zoom';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(gridZoom, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 54 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `color` | color | `"#FF4F1A"` |  | Colour of the other tiles; use the incoming scene's background colour. |
| `background` | color | `"#111111"` |  | Colour between the tiles. |
| `zoom` | number | `0.3` | 0.15–0.6 | Tile size when pulled back, as a share of the frame. |
| `direction` | enum | `"left"` | `left` · `right` · `up` · `down` | Direction the motion travels. |
